name: RY-CX two-qubit reduced von Neumann entropy
task_prompt: Prepare RY(1.1) on qubit 0 followed by CX(0,1). Using qiskit.quantum_info only, compute the two-qubit Statevector, trace out qubit 1, and calculate the base-2 von Neumann entropy of qubit 0. Independently evaluate h2(sin^2(theta/2)), handle zero logarithms safely, print both values, and assert agreement within 1e-12. Respond with a single runnable Python file and no prose outside the code. The program must be CPU-runnable, deterministic where practical, and fail loudly through assertions when a requested property is not met.
